title: Kagamine Rin — No Head Pats, Thank You!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, we should probably head out now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Have fun at work!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take a quick break before we resume practice?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, can we talk about some stuff?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure! What do you wanna talk about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I wanna ask you two more about the work research shadowing program thing you told us about!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The shadowing program?
Then, what if we told her more about our office visit?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That might be good.
It did have a pretty interesting “we plan events” feeling to it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Like what?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In one corner of their office, they had a big pile of equipment that they use for their events! That really made it feel like an event company!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, really?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The person right next to the pile did seem a little bit cramped...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But they said they liked it better working in a smaller space like that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha. I think I understand!
Like when you're playing hide and seek and you hide in the broom closet. It's pretty comfy in there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't think that's quite what they meant...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, they also had a bunch of event posters pinned up around the office. You probably wouldn't get that at other companies.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
There were so many all lined up! Just looking at them was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, I really liked the desks of the people who worked there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Their desks?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A lot of people had special tools and catalogs on their desks, but some also had game cases and children's books lined up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The lady who showed us around had a bunch of merch of event mascots on her desk.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And she told us...

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: One reason why I have these on my desk is because I think they're really cute, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: But they also represent the joy I feel each time I get to see our guests enjoying our events, and connecting with the heart of what we're doing.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: I won't forget that sensation as long as they're on my desk, and I feel motivated to do my best for our next event.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They remind her of her past accomplishments, which in turn drive her to keep doing her best... That's really cool!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And she isn't alone. Apparently, her company recommends all of their employees do the same!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, everyone did have a lot of merch on their desks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right♪ The entire place had this glittery glow to it, like they were all having so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A glittery glow...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I know what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's like when you're writing songs, Sakki. Or when Shih is practicing on her own, or when all of you are playing together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You all make the air around you sparkle, because you're doing what you love with all your hearts!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I mean, I dunno if we make the air sparkle...
Being pros comes with certain responsibilities and resolutions, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Hehe. Still, people do sorta shine whenever they're doing something they really love...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Which means the employees at that company are just like Sakki and the others. They must have a lot of great memories.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Now I really can't wait to see what the event they said they'll be helping out with is gonna be like!)
